allocation: equal n_per_stratum drawn independently inside each of the four oracle_type × platform_verdict strata
boundary_meaning: expand iff observed_sample_error_rate > error_rate_threshold; a stratum whose rate equals the threshold is silent. Specified before any rate is computed so the boundary is not left to floating-point luck.
selection_method: Within each stratum, sort case_id lexicographically, shuffle with random.Random(int(sha256(utf8(frame_seed || '|' || stratum_id))[:16], 16)), take the first n_per_stratum ids. The draw is a function of (seed, population, stratum), not a hand-picked list.
stratum_definition: cartesian product oracle_type ∈ {deterministic, judged} × platform_verdict ∈ {fail, pass}. Every ledger row lands in exactly one stratum.
threshold_citation: Phase-11 spec _USER-PROMPTS.md:11041 — expand re-verification of the entire affected class when the sampled error rate exceeds a predefined threshold. The 0.10 floor is declared here before any TST-0323 error rate is computed; it is not fitted to the synthetic ledger.
